title: Greedy ES direction SNR 32-to-128-pair scale control
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: The negative split-half direction correlation at 32 pairs per opponent is estimator under-sampling rather than intrinsically unlearnable signal; extending the exact same zero-center, sigma0.8 directions and deck prefixes to 128 pairs per opponent will make half and mean quarter rank correlations positive and stabilize at least four of eight direction signs.
material_change: Freeze the exact prior center, random-feature model seed, eight normalized directions, sigma, six training opponents, seats, and pair0-31 evidence. Generate only pair32-127 supplements, then recompute direction fitness on four disjoint 32-pair quarters, two 64-pair halves, and the full 128-pair cohort. Do not update weights or run validation/Slumbot.
baseline: At 32 pairs per opponent, all eight directions activated but independent 16-pair halves had Pearson correlation -0.6313 and the resulting center validation slope was -21.35 +/-41.85 bb/100. This control tests sample efficiency, not strength.

result.summary: The fixed-center sigma0.8 ES direction cohort was extended exactly from 32 to 128 common-deck pairs per each of six opponents, adding 18,432 environment hands. The original prefix reproduced exactly. Half-cohort rank correlation improved to +0.1190 and 6/8 direction signs agreed in at least three quarters, but mean pairwise quarter rank correlation remained -0.0913 (range -0.6429 to +0.4286). All 266 tests passed.
result.conclusion: Fourfold sampling improves the direction estimator but does not make its ordering reliably reproducible: independent quarter rankings remain anti-correlated on average. Applying the full128 update would violate the preregistered mechanism gate. This is evidence that the current 585-parameter, eight-direction greedy-ES recipe is too sample-inefficient on this hardware/broad league, not evidence that larger training budgets should make every method win Slumbot or that ES is universally invalid.
result.next_step: Close this ES recipe without applying the posthoc full128 direction. Return to methods with per-decision credit and better data efficiency, but require any next scalable route to demonstrate multi-seed geometric slope, broad opponent/seat gains, Standard10 preservation, and proxy/external directional agreement before large allocation.
